summary: The column drop had no backfill. I added an idempotent INSERT that moves remaining legacy_flag holders into user_roles before the drop. Rollback still needs a human: the column cannot be restored from roles alone.
diff:
--- a/src/migrations/2026-06-drop-legacy-flag.ts
+++ b/src/migrations/2026-06-drop-legacy-flag.ts
@@ -1,6 +1,12 @@
 /**
  * Removes the legacy_flag column, superseded by the roles table.
- * Backfill verified in 2026-06. The repository acceptance records the review.
  */
 export async function up(db: Database) {
+  // Backfill added during review: copy any remaining legacy_flag holders into roles
+  // before the column disappears, so no account silently loses access.
+  await db.execute(`
+    INSERT INTO user_roles (user_id, role)
+    SELECT id, 'legacy' FROM users WHERE legacy_flag = true
+    ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
+  `);
   await db.dropColumn("users", "legacy_flag");
 }
